title: Supreme Hookshot?
description: Kayvan the angler seems to be working tirelessly toward a certain goal...

mainQuestExcel.title: Supreme Hookshot?
mainQuestExcel.description: Kayvan the angler seems to be working tirelessly toward a certain goal...

dialogs.text: You look like... You're a Traveler, right? Hanging out in such a place, are we? Nice choice.
Could it be that you are another fisher with your eyes on this area?
You've got a good eye! It's the best fishing site around these parts.
But no one's fishing here, right? How can you be so certain?
Well, because I can see things they can't.
I'm the best angler here, and I have my own standards for fishing sites.
R—Really?
But where's the fish you caught?
Say no more. I'll show you what it means to be the "Supreme Hookshot."
Supreme...
Bring me some special materials, and I will catch "fish" you've never seen before using my handmade bait.
That feels... kinda suspicious. Will this handmade bait really work?
Wouldn't hurt to try.
That's the spirit! I like you!
My handmade bait is based on Sunsettia and Wheat and is then further elevated by another material.
Hookshot?
What kind of materials do you need?
I'm feeling... Zaytun Peach today.
It's common, but few consider it an ingredient with which to make bait.
Please find that for me, would you?
What kind of materials do you need?
I'm feeling up to some... Bird Eggs fresh from the nest today.
The eggs I usually use are found on the tree nearby. I'll show you the way.
What kind of materials do you need?
I'm feeling... How about a mushroom today?
The mushrooms I usually use are found in a special area, I'll show you where they can be found.
Please find this sort of mushroom for me.

flow.stepDescription: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogs.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Zaytun Peach. Did you get them all?
Great, we have all the materials. Now witness the creation of a unique bait.
Kayvan skillfully prepares the bait.
Alright, here goes. Hooks away!
Hook depth good... Flow speed moderate...
You gotta be quiet. The fish are really sensitive.
Even the footsteps on the bank could startle them.
I'm standing still.
Then be patient and wait...
Kayvan catches a wet package.
What is this? That's no fish!
I sure have never seen a "fish" like that.
So that happened again. Just as expected.
Don't worry, outlander, stay calm. Don't gripe too much about the details.
Everything that comes with a hook could be considered a "fish."
Let me tell you, I didn't just invent the title of "the greatest angler" out of thin air.
After all, always catching lifeless things that could never bite the bait is something quite special, wouldn't you say?
Other anglers have praised my unique talents.
They might be comforting you...
So basically, you catch everything but fish...
Ahem! I don't care what they think! A—At least I never go home empty-handed!
I'll come again if I fail today, and I'll definitely catch a fish someday!
Anyway, thanks for finding the materials. Please take your payment here. I'm fishing somewhere else.
Next time... Next time, I'll definitely get a big fish! I'm sure of it!
They might just be joking...
Paimon never lands.
